title: 深開挖內支撐預壓~Preloading of deep-excavation struts
focus: 內支撐預壓、溫度軸力與分階段卸載~Strut preload, thermal axial force and staged unloading
summary: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。~Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines.

units.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證~Contact gap mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。~Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers. The target must therefore follow overall excavation deformation and member resistance rather than a desire to maximize initial force. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。~Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness. Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization.
units.failure: 接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。~Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.
units.misconception: 千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。~The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed.
units.practice: 預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。~Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.

units.anchor: 支撐軸向剛度~Strut axial stiffness
units.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證~Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。真實系統還包括接頭及壁體柔度，串聯柔度會降低整體剛度；用單根鋼管剛度代表完整支撐線可能低估開挖位移。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。~Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness. Using the steel member alone to represent the entire support line can therefore underestimate excavation movement and misrepresent load sharing. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。~Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness. Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes.
units.failure: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。~Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.
units.misconception: 截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。~A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
units.practice: 分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。~Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.

units.anchor: 溫度附加軸力~Thermal axial force
units.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證~Thermal axial force mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。完全拘束給出上限尺度，但壁體與接頭柔度會釋放部分熱應變；監測若未扣除溫度，可能把可逆熱力誤判為土壓需求突然增加。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。~Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained. Full restraint gives a bounding scale, while wall and connection flexibility release part of the thermal strain. Without temperature correction, monitoring may misinterpret reversible thermal force as a sudden increase in earth-pressure demand. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.
units.model: 原創教學假設：完全拘束下E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、α=12×10⁻⁶/K、ΔT=10 K，ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Under full restraint, E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m², α=12×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT=10 K give ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 在受光及背光位置量測鋼溫，對時比對軸力與壁移，分辨日循環和持續增長的土壓作用。軸力警戒應注明溫度基準與修正方式；設計者審核總力及去溫度趨勢，兩者都不可省略。~Measure steel temperature in exposed and shaded locations, aligning force and wall movement to distinguish daily cycles from sustained earth-pressure growth. Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other.
units.failure: 忽略熱力可能誤觸發警報，也可能在最高溫時低估支撐總軸力與挫屈需求。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。~Ignoring thermal force can cause false alarms or underestimate total axial and buckling demand at the highest temperature. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.
units.misconception: 支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。~A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
units.practice: 軸力警戒應注明溫度基準與修正方式；設計者審核總力及去溫度趨勢，兩者都不可省略。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。~Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.

units.title: 座板局部承壓的機理與驗證~Seat bearing mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 支撐軸力須經座板、加勁肋及圍檁傳到擋土壁，局部接觸面常比構件截面更容易控制。座板翹曲或墊塊不平會縮小有效面積並增加偏心；平均承壓只有在接觸分布合理時才能用來描述局部需求。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。~Strut force passes through seats, stiffeners and walers into the wall, and local contact may govern before the member section. Warped plates or uneven packing reduce effective area and increase eccentricity. Mean bearing pressure describes local demand only where the assumed contact distribution is credible. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設力P=800 kN、有效接觸A=0.04 m²，平均p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For force P=800 kN over effective contact A=0.04 m², mean p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 檢查接觸面平整及加勁位置，量測座板轉角，對照反力是否通過設計傳力中心。預壓前必須驗收接觸及加勁細部；座板變形異常由連接設計者評估，不能只換更大的千斤頂。~Inspect contact flatness and stiffener location, measure seat rotation, and check whether the reaction passes through the intended transfer centre. Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack.
units.failure: 小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。~Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.
units.misconception: 支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。~Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat.
units.practice: 預壓前必須驗收接觸及加勁細部；座板變形異常由連接設計者評估，不能只換更大的千斤頂。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。~Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.

units.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證~Lock-off loss mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。鎖定前讀值不是長期保留力，且溫度變化也會干擾比較；設計上需區分施加力、移交力與後續開挖引起的力增量。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。~Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip. The pre-lock reading is not retained force, and temperature changes complicate comparison. Design must distinguish applied force, transferred force and increments caused by subsequent excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比較鎖定前後同一量測系統的軸力與位移，記錄溫度及座板狀態，確認損失是否持續發展。驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。~Compare force and displacement before and after lock-off using the same system, recording temperature and seating condition to see whether losses continue. Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided.
units.failure: 只記施加峰值會高估保留預壓，後續開挖時壁體可能先移動才重新接觸支撐。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。~Recording only the applied peak overstates retained preload, allowing the wall to move before restraint fully re-engages during excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.
units.misconception: 鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。~Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.
units.practice: 驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。~Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.

units.title: 多支撐互制的機理與驗證~Interaction between struts mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 預壓一支支撐會推動圍檁與壁體，改變鄰近支撐的長度及軸力，因此各支撐並非互相獨立。施加順序及剛度差異決定反力分配，局部達到目標力可能同時使另一支卸載；整體平衡要以同一時間的力值判定。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。~Preloading one strut moves the waler and wall, changing neighbouring lengths and forces. Supports are therefore coupled through stiffness and sequence. Achieving a local target may unload another strut, so overall equilibrium must use simultaneous readings rather than peaks recorded at different times. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設本支撐增加ΔP₁=100 kN、鄰支撐減少60 kN，兩支合計增量ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: If one strut gains ΔP₁=100 kN and its neighbour loses 60 kN, their combined increment is ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步讀取整個支撐層的力與圍檁位移，逐段比較力增量矩陣，核對反力總和及作用位置。預壓及複測順序應由臨時工程設計者指定，驗收採同時力場；不得以逐支歷史最大值取代。~Read the complete support level simultaneously with waler movement, compare incremental interaction patterns, and check reaction sums and positions. The temporary-works designer specifies preload and recheck sequence, and acceptance uses a simultaneous force field rather than individual historical maxima.
units.failure: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。~Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.
units.misconception: 每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。~If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously.
units.practice: 預壓及複測順序應由臨時工程設計者指定，驗收採同時力場；不得以逐支歷史最大值取代。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。~The temporary-works designer specifies preload and recheck sequence, and acceptance uses a simultaneous force field rather than individual historical maxima. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.

units.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證~Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。~Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress. Local modifications can increase sensitivity of the entire support line. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。~Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties. Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance.
units.failure: 小偏心在高軸力下可形成顯著彎矩，局部側向支承失效會進一步放大變形並降低穩定餘裕。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。~Small eccentricity under high compression produces significant bending; lost lateral support further magnifies deformation and reduces stability margin. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.
units.misconception: 壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。~Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
units.practice: 不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。~Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.

units.title: 液壓力校正的機理與驗證~Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 千斤頂壓力乘有效活塞面積可估施力，但回油側壓力、摩擦及校正誤差會使真實力偏離理想值。壓力表量到的是液壓系統狀態，不能獨立證明支撐已受力；應與載重計或構件應變以及位移同步比對。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。~Pressure times effective piston area estimates jack force, but return pressure, friction and calibration error alter actual output. A pressure gauge measures the hydraulic system rather than independently proving force in the strut. Compare it with a load cell or member strain and with displacement on a synchronized time base. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設有效差壓p=20 MPa、有效活塞面積A=0.04 m²，F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For effective differential pressure p=20 MPa and piston area A=0.04 m², F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對活塞有效面積與校正證書，在核定範圍比對獨立載重計，檢查升降載遲滯及讀值零點。每組千斤頂、壓力表及載重計應有配對編碼；設備更換後由試驗負責人重核轉換關係再使用。~Verify effective piston area and calibration certificates, compare with an independent load cell within the approved range, and check loading-unloading hysteresis and zero offsets. Pair-code each jack, gauge and load cell; the testing lead rechecks the conversion after equipment changes before further use.
units.failure: 用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。~Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.
units.misconception: 壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。~Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
units.practice: 每組千斤頂、壓力表及載重計應有配對編碼；設備更換後由試驗負責人重核轉換關係再使用。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。~Pair-code each jack, gauge and load cell; the testing lead rechecks the conversion after equipment changes before further use. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.

units.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證~Wall movement rate mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。位移持續加速可能代表支承尚未形成、土體潛變或地下水變化；短時間跳點則需先排除測量基準或儀器問題，不能把所有異常都歸因於地層失穩。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。~Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis. Sustained acceleration may indicate incomplete restraint, soil creep or groundwater changes, whereas a sudden isolated jump first requires checks of datum and instrument integrity. Not every anomalous reading establishes ground instability, but trends must not be dismissed without evidence. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比對傾度計、獨立測量及開挖日誌，檢查讀值是否同向持續，並同步查看支撐力與外水頭。監測計畫應並列累積量、速率及資料品質檢查；異常由地工與臨時工程負責人共同判讀後決定下一階段。~Compare inclinometers, independent survey and excavation logs for persistent directional movement while checking strut force and external head simultaneously. Monitoring plans include cumulative movement, rate and data-quality checks; geotechnical and temporary-works leads jointly interpret anomalies before deciding the next stage.
units.failure: 只設總位移警報可能錯過快速惡化，過度平滑資料又會掩蓋施工事件造成的短時加速。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。~A cumulative-only trigger can miss rapid deterioration, while excessive smoothing conceals short-term acceleration associated with construction events. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.
units.misconception: 累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。~Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger.
units.practice: 監測計畫應並列累積量、速率及資料品質檢查；異常由地工與臨時工程負責人共同判讀後決定下一階段。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。~Monitoring plans include cumulative movement, rate and data-quality checks; geotechnical and temporary-works leads jointly interpret anomalies before deciding the next stage. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.

units.title: 卸載回彈的機理與驗證~Unloading rebound mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 永久樓板或其他支承接管荷載後，內支撐卸載會釋放儲存彈性能，使壁體及連接產生回彈。回彈方向與既有塑性變形不一定相同，不能假設解除預壓就回到施工前的位置；卸載分析需包含替代支承剛度與接觸狀態。回彈估算假設線性卸載且接觸不變，未含塑性、摩擦與土體時效；不能把四毫米直接當許可的卸載變位。~When permanent slabs or other restraints take over, strut unloading releases stored elastic energy and causes wall and connection rebound. The rebound need not reverse accumulated plastic deformation or restore the original position. Analysis must include replacement-support stiffness and contact state rather than treating preload removal as a simple return to zero. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設釋放力ΔP=600 kN、等效卸載剛度k=150 MN/m，回彈δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For released force ΔP=600 kN and unloading stiffness k=150 MN/m, rebound δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測卸載期間的支撐力、壁移及永久樓板應變，確認荷載確實移交到核定構件而非失去支承。拆撐前由臨時及永久結構設計者共同簽認接管條件；保留卸載曲線及殘餘位移作為營運基準。~Measure strut force, wall movement and permanent-slab strain during unloading to verify actual transfer to approved members rather than loss of restraint. Temporary and permanent designers jointly sign off takeover conditions before removal; retain unloading curves and residual movement as the operational baseline.
units.failure: 未形成替代力流就卸載，可能使壁體向開挖內變形並損傷接縫，無法用重新加壓完全消除。回彈估算假設線性卸載且接觸不變，未含塑性、摩擦與土體時效；不能把四毫米直接當許可的卸載變位。~Unloading before a replacement path exists can move the wall inward and damage joints, with effects that reloading may not fully reverse. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement.
units.misconception: 卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。~Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
units.practice: 拆撐前由臨時及永久結構設計者共同簽認接管條件；保留卸載曲線及殘餘位移作為營運基準。回彈估算假設線性卸載且接觸不變，未含塑性、摩擦與土體時效；不能把四毫米直接當許可的卸載變位。~Temporary and permanent designers jointly sign off takeover conditions before removal; retain unloading curves and residual movement as the operational baseline. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement.

example: 原創教學例：假設支撐接觸後的等效剛度k=200 kN/mm，施加力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。保持剛度不變，力增量提高10%至660 kN，縮短為3.3 mm。實際千斤頂行程還包含座板間隙、圍檁、壁體及設備變形，因此不能用這個三毫米推定全部接觸已閉合。驗證應將力與兩端位移同步記錄，先辨識接觸前後剛度變化，再檢查保留預壓、溫度軸力和鄰支撐互制。這些值是原創假設，不是現場施壓指令。~Original teaching example: assume post-contact support stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, giving elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. With stiffness fixed, a 10% increase to 660 kN gives 3.3 mm. Actual jack stroke also includes seating gaps, waler deformation, wall movement and equipment compliance, so this shortening cannot establish complete contact. Verification records force and both end movements simultaneously, identifies the stiffness change at seating, then checks retained preload, thermal force and interaction with neighbouring struts. These are original assumptions rather than instructions for applying force on site.
history: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm
合成教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m
合成教學假設：完全拘束下E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、α=12×10⁻⁶/K、ΔT=10 K，ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN~Synthetic teaching assumptions: Under full restraint, E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m², α=12×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT=10 K give ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN
合成教學假設：假設力P=800 kN、有效接觸A=0.04 m²，平均p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For force P=800 kN over effective contact A=0.04 m², mean p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa
合成教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%
合成教學假設：假設本支撐增加ΔP₁=100 kN、鄰支撐減少60 kN，兩支合計增量ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN~Synthetic teaching assumptions: If one strut gains ΔP₁=100 kN and its neighbour loses 60 kN, their combined increment is ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN
